name: Feishu

prompts.text: Summarize the Feishu document about the Q3 launch plan.
What did the project group discuss today?
Draft a Feishu document with the agenda for next week's team meeting.

description: Feishu lets agents read and edit cloud documents and read messages and groups in the signed-in Feishu account. Each user signs in to their own Feishu account through the browser.
